narrative.overview: Scoped to the shipped Tower 98 game. Compact utility chrome surrounds original pixel construction artwork; this is an extension of the existing IT Things identity.
keyCharacteristics: Blue sky and shaded red pixel floors
Compact monospace controls and readable numeric HUD
Shared retro actions and confirmation dialog
Leaderboard replaces the playfield and suspends gameplay

rules.name: Scope
rules.body: These scene and layout decisions apply only to Tower 98, not the global application.

dos: Preserve shared controls, mobile tap targets, and focused canvas keyboard input.
Draw crane attachments and floors from physics coordinates.
donts: Do not introduce native browser dialogs or independent action-button styling.
Do not duplicate nearby status copy or promote the scene palette to a global identity.
